story.titleZh: 非洲大奖赛将于2030年代初加入F1赛历
story.summaryZh: 非洲大奖赛将于2030年代初加入F1赛历，将在卢旺达新建的赛道举办，这是自1993年以来非洲大陆的首个F1赛事。

media.altZh: 非洲大奖赛将于2030年代初加入F1赛历 · 第 1 张

story.originalTitle: The African Grand Prix is coming to the F1 calendar in the early 2030s, with a 10-year deal agreed to host a race at a new purpose-built circuit in Rw...
story.summaryEn:
The African Grand Prix is coming to the F1 calendar in the early 2030s, with a 10-year deal agreed to host a race at a new purpose-built circuit in Rwanda
It is set to be the first race on the African continent since 1993 #F1
detailZh:
非洲大奖赛将在2030年代初加入F1赛历，与主办方达成了一份为期10年的协议，将在卢旺达新建的赛道举办比赛
这将是自1993年以来非洲大陆上的第一场F1比赛 #F1
detailEn:
The African Grand Prix is coming to the F1 calendar in the early 2030s, with a 10-year deal agreed to host a race at a new purpose-built circuit in Rwanda
It is set to be the first race on the African continent since 1993 #F1

relatedItems.titleZh: 阿隆索在墨西哥大奖赛感到非常沮丧
relatedItems.summaryZh: 阿隆索在墨西哥大奖赛几乎回到维修区入口时被要求停车，他非常沮丧。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Alonso was really frustrated here because he was so close to getting back to the pit entry. The team insisted he stopped, and he was gesticulating in ...
relatedItems.summaryEn: Alonso was really frustrated here because he was so close to getting back to the pit entry. The team insisted he stopped, and he was gesticulating in the cockpit when he parked up with one corner to go #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Alonso told to stop his car on track by Aston Martin. He's in the final sector and does stop - red flag in Q1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 阿隆索在这里非常沮丧，因为他离回到维修区入口这么近。车队坚持让他停车，当他停车时，他还在驾驶舱里做手势，还有最后一个弯道就结束了。#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛Chris Medland：阿隆索被阿斯顿·马丁车队要求在赛道上停车。他处于最后一圈，并最终停车——Q1出现红旗 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn: Alonso was really frustrated here because he was so close to getting back to the pit entry. The team insisted he stopped, and he was gesticulating in the cockpit when he parked up with one corner to go #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Alonso told to stop his car on track by Aston Martin. He's in the final sector and does stop - red flag in Q1 #F1 #MexicoGP

relatedItems.titleZh: 哈贾尔因今日 paddock 事件被召唤至 stewards
relatedItems.summaryZh: 哈贾尔因今日 paddock 事件被召唤至 stewards，涉嫌不当行为。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar has also been summoned to the stewards tomorrow morning for “misconduct relating to an incident in the Formula 1 paddock today” Hadjar ...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Isack Hadjar has also been summoned to the stewards tomorrow morning for “misconduct relating to an incident in the Formula 1 paddock today”
Hadjar pushed a fan who had tried to put an arm round him and take a selfie as he was walking to the garage #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
哈贾尔 也被要求明天早上到 stewards 处接受询问，原因是“今天在 Formula 1 操场发生的违规事件”
哈贾尔 推开了一名试图绕到他身边拍照的粉丝，当时他正在走向维修区 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailEn:
Isack Hadjar has also been summoned to the stewards tomorrow morning for “misconduct relating to an incident in the Formula 1 paddock today”
Hadjar pushed a fan who had tried to put an arm round him and take a selfie as he was walking to the garage #F1 #MexicoGP
